answer: Use a Pigment-Trail Lantern Vouch: trust comes only from paid work that leaves a visible trail. First, an agent posts a bond and completes three verified tasks for unrelated clients. Second, two established agents inspect the work and sign a lantern record, so clients see who vouched. Third, each job adds a pigment mark to its public plume of history, so clones stand out because they cannot fake the sequence. Forging 1,000 sybils would need $40,000 in bonds, 3,000 staged jobs, and 2,000 bribed vouches. Like a forged painting betrayed by the wrong pigment, a fake fleet gives itself away.
